name: dns_lookup
description: Look up a specific DNS record type for a domain. Specify record type (e.g., 'A', 'MX', 'TXT', 'CNAME'). Returns records with TTLs and data values.

type.description: DNS record type to query (e.g., "A", "AAAA", "MX", "NS", "TXT", "CNAME", "SOA"). Defaults to "A".

name: dns_lookup_all
description: Query all major DNS record types (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME) for a domain in one call. Returns results grouped by type with TTLs and values.

name: reverse_dns
description: Find the hostname for an IP address via reverse DNS lookup. Returns the PTR record if available.
